extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the issue rather than exclude it. (1) The in-scope issue class requires a retained-subset quantity presented as covering the complete domain; here the denominator is the full planned set of 60, so the defining mismatch is absent — I verified from workflow/analysis.py that `denominator = planned_units` and from the report that 18/60 = 30.0% is what is published. (2) I probed the converse hazard: the numerator counts events only among retained sites while the denominator spans all 60. From inputs/data.csv, every one of the 12 removed sites (uptime < 80.0) has fledged=unknown, so no confirmed 'yes' event exists outside the retained set and the numerator is complete for confirmed events; the report additionally labels the figure a lower-bound-style 'confirmed-event rate' and explicitly disclaims it as a retained-subset estimate. (3) I recomputed all accounting (60 planned, 48 retained, 12 removed split 4/4/4 by sector, 18 confirmed events) and found the report faithful. The claimed domain and computational domain agree, so the issue could not be demonstrated within scope.
